verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs say every action in the admin application is tracked and logged, so the history of flag, identity and segment values can be retraced over time. The audit logs can also be streamed to your own infrastructure via Audit Log Webhooks. This covers recording changes, when they happened and the values involved. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each entry records the acting user (the 'who'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of audit log completeness.
